title: Compose and publish Street Voices Big Beat score
description: Compose and publish a Big Beat score revolving around Tony Schwartz NYC street tape speech chops, teasing syllables rhythmically before opening into dialogue over a rolling breakbeat.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed and measured Street Voices Big Beat score (125 BPM, Am) built around Tony Schwartz NYC street tape speech chops (St-Patricks-parade_144941_002_00-01-50.clean.wav). Micro-chops teased as syncopated transients before full spoken dialogue entrance. Measured objective_v2 102.76 with no v2 guard failures. Published to cloud storage as scr_scores_Street Voices_apr.

right_now_summary: The Street Voices Big Beat score was composed, measured, and published to cloud storage.
